about: P3.4 parameter profile: the only ArduPilot parameters the app reads, saves, loads, exports or sets (owner rule 2026-10-09: return height, speed limits, geofence, failsafe actions, flight modes). Names, meanings and ranges from https://ardupilot.org/copter/docs/parameters.html read 2026-10-09 (this SITL build: ArduCopter V4.7.2-beta1). Never: SIM_* (simulator only), frame or motor settings, sensor calibration, tuning (PID) or battery capacity (in this simulator it is shaped to make the drain rate). Used by bridge/contract.py and web/src/net/contract.ts.

params.name: PILOT_SPD_DN
params.title: Pilot maximum descent speed (0 uses PILOT_SPD_UP)

params.name: FENCE_TYPE
params.title: Geofence types (bitmask: 1 max height, 2 circle, 4 polygons, 8 min height)

params.name: FENCE_ACTION
params.title: Geofence breach action (0 report, 1 RTL or land, 2 land, 3-5 SmartRTL or brake variants)

params.name: FENCE_MARGIN
params.title: Distance to keep from the fence

params.name: FS_GCS_ENABLE
params.title: Ground station lost: action (0 none, 1 RTL, 3 SmartRTL, 4, 5 land, 6, 7)

params.name: FS_THR_ENABLE
params.title: Radio throttle lost: action (0 off, 1 RTL, 3 land, 4-7)

params.name: FS_EKF_ACTION
params.title: Position estimate lost: action (0 report, 1 land, 2 AltHold, 3 land always)

params.name: BATT_FS_LOW_ACT
params.title: Low battery action (0 warn, 1 land, 2 RTL, 3-7)

params.name: BATT_FS_CRT_ACT
params.title: Critical battery action (0 warn, 1 land, 2 RTL, 3-7)

params.name: FLTMODE_CH
params.title: Radio channel for flight modes (0 off, 5-15)
